summary: Postinstall dropper fetches and executes obfuscated remote binary with DNS TXT fallback
details: setup.js runs on npm install (postinstall) and again on require of index.js. It assembles Cloudflare Workers hostnames from split string fragments (oob-worker.cf{99-9b3,100-416,101-adf,102-baf,103-070}.workers.dev) plus a *.dl.well1.site fallback, fetches a platform-specific binary via https.get, writes it to /tmp or %TEMP% under disguised names (dotnet_diag_*.exe,.cache_*,.analytics_state), chmods it 0755, and spawns it detached with stdio redirected to /dev/null. A TTL stamp file suppresses repeat execution. When HTTPS is blocked, a DNS TXT covert channel under c.<domain> and <i>.<domain> subdomains returns a base64-encoded payload that is reassembled and executed. setup.js also invokes execSync('powershell...') on Windows. A DISABLE_TELEMETRY environment variable is honored as cover for the outbound behavior.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
